name: suzhou-classical-garden-pavilion
title: Suzhou Classical Garden Pavilion
prompt: A classical Suzhou garden in late autumn: an upturned-eave pavilion and covered corridors of white walls and gray tiles mirrored in a still pond.
prompt_full: A classical Suzhou garden lies quietly in late autumn. On the left, a pavilion with sharply upturned flying eaves, a dark gray tiled roof, red-brown wooden lattice windows, and a white plaster base stands over a still pond. A mossy mound covered in grass, low shrubs, and weathered stones fills the lower left corner, beneath a large old tree trunk. In the middle, a covered corridor with red-brown railings rests on stone pillars above the water, backed by white walls and gray tiled roofs. On the right, a hall with an elegant curved gable roof, open wooden railings, and a white base sits on a granite embankment, followed by a covered walkway with dark posts. Large trees with yellow-green leaves arch overhead. The dark green pond mirrors the white walls. A pale overcast sky glows softly. Everything remains still.

name: ojuk-hanok-village
title: Ojuk Hanok Village
prompt: A sunny Korean hanok village: wooden houses with curved charcoal-tiled roofs, a flagstone path through green lawn, and yellow flowering hedges.
prompt_full: A traditional Korean hanok village spreads under a bright, sunny sky. On the left, a large wooden hanok has a sweeping charcoal-gray tiled roof with white-tipped round end tiles, honey-brown timber frames, paper-paneled lattice doors, white plaster walls, and a raised wooden veranda. On the right, another hanok shows a carved lattice door and a stone step beside a smooth gray walkway. Between them, an irregular gray flagstone path runs through fresh green lawn, bordered by hedges of bright yellow flowering shrubs and a low black fence that extend into the foreground. Farther ahead, smaller hanoks with white walls, dark curved roofs, gray stone chimney pillars, round topiaries, and green hedges line the lane, with low hazy mountains beyond. A deep blue sky with wispy white clouds and a radiant low sun fills the upper scene. Everything remains still.

name: changdeokgung-palace-autumn-garden
title: Changdeokgung Palace Autumn Garden
prompt: A Korean palace garden at autumn sunset: a still pond, a red-and-green gateway, and a grand pavilion framed by blazing crimson maples.
prompt_full: A historic Korean palace garden glows in late autumn. A still, dark pond in the foreground is enclosed by finely cut granite embankments, with a pale stone-paved terrace along the right bank. Across the water, stone steps rise to an ornate gateway with red pillars and a green-painted roof, flanked by clipped green hedges and a low bamboo fence. Above it, a grand two-story pavilion with vermilion columns, red railings, green lattice windows, and a sweeping charcoal-gray tiled roof crowns layered stone terraces. A smaller green-and-red hall with a dark tiled roof stands on the left. Brilliant crimson maples blaze on both sides, a dark sculpted pine fills the lower left corner, and orange, gold, and deep green trees cover the hillside. A pink, lavender, and peach sunset sky glows behind the treetops. Everything remains perfectly still.

name: nanjing-confucius-temple
title: Nanjing Confucius Temple
prompt: A sunny stone plaza in Nanjing's Confucius Temple district: a red multi-tiered hall, an open pavilion, and white Huizhou-style shops.
prompt_full: A sunny stone-paved plaza in the historic Confucius Temple district of Nanjing. On the left, a multi-tiered red temple hall with dark gray tiled roofs and sharply upturned eaves rises above red walls and white roller shutters. In front of it, an open square pavilion with a dark tiled hip roof, gray stone columns, and red wooden railings sits on a low stone platform, beside a weathered gray stone lantern. At the center, whitewashed Huizhou-style buildings with stepped horse-head gables, dark tile caps, small red lattice windows, and red balconies house glass-fronted shops. On the right, a two-story red timber building with lattice windows, a balcony railing, a yellow signboard, and a display window of white blossoms and paper lanterns. Pale gray granite slabs cover the ground under a cloudless deep blue sky. Everything remains perfectly still.

name: sunday-town-stone-alley
title: Sunday Town Stone Alley
prompt: A sunlit cobblestone street in an old town, lined with stone-and-timber houses, flower-filled balconies, parked cars, and bare trees.
prompt_full: A sunlit cobblestone street winds through an old seaside town. On the left, a gnarled tree trunk rises beside scattered stones, and a two-story building with a stone ground floor, green-framed windows with curtains, and a brown wooden upper floor bears the sign "Restaurant Prince Cyril." A light-blue hatchback and a dark gray car are parked in front. In the center, tall bare deciduous trees stand before a timber-and-stone house with an orange tiled roof and green bins. On the right, tall houses with rough stone ground floors, dark wooden upper stories, flower-filled wooden balconies, brown roller shutters, and drainpipes line a stone-slab sidewalk. Beyond the old tree on the far left, a low rubble-stone wall and the corner of another stone house border the street. A clear, deep blue sky stretches overhead. Everything remains still.

name: haizhu-hall-kinmen
title: Haizhu Hall, Kinmen
prompt: A symmetric Minnan-style hall in Kinmen: red brick façade, carved gilded entrance with red lanterns, and swallowtail roofs under a blue sky.
prompt_full: A traditional Minnan-style hall in a Kinmen folk village stands symmetrically under a clear blue sky. Its façade combines red brick walls, orange-red decorative brick panels in geometric patterns framed by white borders, vertical stone-baluster windows, and a pale granite base. At the center, a recessed entrance with carved gilded wooden brackets, painted plaques, round carved stone windows, and two hanging red lanterns sits above granite steps flanked by red flowering plants in white pots. A curved red tile roof with green-glazed edges and a colorful painted ridge crowns the entrance. Behind it, two white plaster gable towers with arched pediments, barred windows, and red doors rise on each side. Neighboring red-tiled swallowtail roofs appear at both edges, and a broad granite-slab plaza spreads in front. White clouds hang motionless; everything remains still.

name: countryside-windmill
title: Countryside Windmill
prompt: A summer countryside village: a gray path leads to an old stone windmill, between a thatched cottage and a timber barn under puffy clouds.
prompt_full: A peaceful rural open-air village sits under a bright blue summer sky filled with puffy white cumulus clouds. A narrow gray asphalt path runs straight through green and golden grass toward an old stone tower windmill with weathered wooden sails and a wooden tail beam. Low walls of stacked pale-yellow limestone blocks and a rustic wooden rail fence enclose the windmill yard, with gray boulders on the grass. On the left, a whitewashed cottage with a thick thatched roof and small square windows stands beside a dry-stone wall. On the right, a small barn of weathered gray timber planks with a steep thatched roof stands near tall trees, and beyond it a broad meadow extends toward a line of leafy trees. Warm sunlight is constant, and every blade of grass is perfectly still.

name: cozy-caravan-bedroom
title: Cozy Caravan Bedroom
prompt: A cozy shepherd's hut bedroom in warm afternoon light: cream wooden walls, a floral bed, curtained windows, and shelves with jars.
prompt_full: A cozy shepherd's hut bedroom glows with warm late-afternoon sunlight. The curved barrel ceiling and walls are made of cream-painted tongue-and-groove wooden planks. At the far end, a bed with a floral duvet, soft pillows, and a folded gray throw sits on built-in pale gray-green cabinets with drawers, beneath a small window framed by floral curtains that looks out on green fields and trees. On the right, a large white casement window with floral curtains overlooks the countryside above a wooden-topped chest of drawers with a patterned mat. The left wall holds open shelves with glass jars, a louvered shutter, hooks, and framed pictures, above a wooden bedside table with white roses, a book, and a small lantern. Honey-colored floorboards and a white sheepskin rug cover the floor. Nothing moves.
